title: fv_identify_verdict
description: Vision-confirm verdict for one live snap against a numbered candidate list. assetId is a candidate id copied verbatim from the prompt, or the sentinel string 'none' (schemas cannot union with null).

assetId.description: The chosen candidate's numeric id, copied verbatim from the prompt and rendered as a string (e.g. "12"), or "none" when no candidate matches, the snap is unusable, or no images were supplied. Never an id absent from the candidate list.

confidence.description: How certain the match is. Bound restated because numeric min/max are not preserved server-side: 0 to 1 inclusive, never below 0, never above 1. Exactly 0 whenever assetId is "none".

reason.description: One short sentence naming the concrete visual evidence for the verdict (label text, shape, mounting, surroundings). No preamble.
